title: SunIsDead
description: This datapack makes the whole minecraft survival experience something more challenging.
body:
This datapack makes the whole minecraft survival experience something more challenging.

 

**Features:**

 

The sun ceases to exist, that is, the entire game is at night.(You will have a few seconds at the beginning of the game to prepare yourself)
Sleep is no longer allowed, attempts will have consequences...
The mobs had modifications in their attributes (life, speed,...) and gained abilities.
Some mobs have health regeneration.
Player natural regeneration has been disabled
Some neutral mobs have become permanently aggressive.
At certain times, events such as "wear and tear" or "nightmare" occurred.
During the "nightmare" event:
- All pigs will be turned into zombies.

- All skeleton horses will be traps.

- All creepers will be electrified.

- 1 to 3 phantoms have appeared that will explode after 20 seconds.

 

Good luck! 😉
